newsitem.title: MEXICO: MEXICO TO STAGE INTL COFFEE FAIR IN CHIAPAS STATE.
newsitem.headline: MEXICO TO STAGE INTL COFFEE FAIR IN CHIAPAS STATE.

text.p: Mexico's southern state of Chiapas will host the country's First International Coffee Fair in October, an organiser said Tuesday.

The fair, to be staged between October 12-15 in the tiny town of Cacahoatan close to the Guatemalan border, is being organised by the Agriculture Ministry, the Mexican Coffee Council and other coffee associations based in Chiapas.

Organiser Victor Mendez said Ruben Castillo Fragaso, the executive director of the council, will inaugurate the fair. Another presentation will be made on Chiapas coffee production and estimates to the year 2000.
Cacahoatan is a town with a 5,600 population where 90 percent of the local economy derives from coffee production, Mendez said.
